latest.title: Size supply for 24/7 or for demand, and find stock no plan sends on
latest.summary: Supply now judges every item once and uses the same word for it everywhere: covered, tight, short, no plan, paused, stalled, idle, made here or new. A Sizing switch on Orders, on the factory and import checks and on each warehouse and factory page sizes your factory lines, top-ups and imports for 24/7 rated output or for what your shops actually use, with one 15% margin over the whole chain from import to sale and figures rounded up to tens. Under Demand, a shop open less than a week is projected forward and marked "may still be ramping". Tight means an order covers the use but not the margin; it shows on Supply and never on Today. Shops and warehouses stocked by a repeating wholesale contract are judged against it. A new Not routed finding points at stock in a warehouse or factory that no plan sends on while your own shops sell it.
